parsed.internal_thinking: Charlie has 2 revealed knights and a hidden dev card. If that hidden card is the third knight, he wins immediately with Largest Army (3 VP + 2 VP = 5). He just rolled a 4, giving him more wheat. He's gloating, which usually means he has the win in hand. My game is likely over before I could use the wheat port.
parsed.note_to_self: Charlie won the game by securing Largest Army (3 Knights) for 5 total VP. My strategy with the wheat port was sound but too slow against his development card rush.
parsed.say_outloud: Fair play, Charlie. You played the development card game perfectly while I was still trying to get my port economy off the ground. Remind me to block your ore next time!
